import json
G=[[8]*20 for _ in range(10)] + [[6]*20]
for r in range(11,20):
    row=[7]*20; row[7]=6
    for c in range(7):
        d=min(r-11,19-r,c,6-c)
        row[c]=[2,0,1][d%3]
    for c in range(8,20):
        d=min(r-11,19-r,c-8,19-c)
        row[c]=[5,1][d%2]
    G.append(row)
print(len(G), [len(x) for x in G]); print(json.dumps(G))
